Neither the plain broad governance reading nor the narrow rule-type mechanism reading (tariff/cost-recovery rules, eligibility, tenure/documentation, regulation, etc.) can be assessed for the target record without its full text.

rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible" for target record). Record RDE1EDA735C46 specifies Fuente D. & Bartram J. (2018), "Pro-poor governance in water and sanitation service delivery: evidence from Global Analysis and Assessment of Sanitation and Drinking Water surveys" (DOI: 10.1177/1757913918788109), whereas the retrieved cached PDF is a completely different publication: P. Cross and A. Morel (2005), "Pro-poor strategies for urban water supply and sanitation services delivery in Africa", Water Science & Technology Vol 51 No 8 pp 51-57. Per mandatory screening rules, guessing from title/metadata or outside memory is prohibited and a wrong-paper PDF mismatch requires decision = "cannot_tell" and exclusion_code = "NONE".
